subject: Proposal: split demo to match CTO airport arrival window
messages:
From: Alex Harper <alex.harper@brightworks.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: CTO may need to join late — can we adjust demo?

Hi Mina,

Quick one — Samir (our CTO) just booked a transcontinental flight and will be arriving the morning of our demo on May 12. He asked if there's any chance we can either shift the session by ~45 minutes earlier or split the meeting so he can join for the executive portion immediately after he lands. He can be available roughly 10:45–11:15 PT but probably not before 10:30.

The rest of our engineering team prefers the original 11:00 slot, so they might not be able to move earlier. If splitting is the simplest path (short exec + follow-up deep dive with the engineers), that would work on our side.

Let me know what works and if you need any supporting materials for the short exec briefing.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Harper
Director, IT Strategy | BrightWorks
attachment: travel_itinerary.pdf (stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@brightworks.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CTO may need to join late — can we adjust demo?

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up. Good news: we have two feasible approaches and I put Marcus (SE) and Lauren (AE) on-thread to confirm availability. Options:

1) Move the full demo earlier by 45 minutes (start 10:15 PT) — keeps it as one session but compresses transitions. Marcus: would that be safe for the deep-dive?
2) Split into a focused 30-minute executive briefing (10:45–11:15 PT) for Samir, then a separate 60–75 minute technical deep-dive with the engineering group afterwards (11:30–12:45). We can record the exec piece and hand off notes to the engineers.

I attached an updated agenda (v2) with a condensed executive path and a technical deep-dive outline so BrightWorks can pick which pieces to prioritize if we go split.

If neither option works, we can also offer an asynchronous exec summary + prioritized Q&A with the CTO after the engineers' session.

Please confirm preference and I'll send calendar invites.

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415 555 0132
attachment: updated_demo_agenda_v2.pdf (stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Harper <alex.harper@brightworks.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CTO may need to join late — can we adjust demo?

Mina / Lauren / Alex — Marcus here. I'm good with option 2 (split). A few practical notes from the SE side:

- Exec briefing (10:45–11:15 PT): we should keep to 25–30 minutes, focused on business impact, latency/cost numbers, and a single customer success example. I'll run a tight slide set + live 3-min highlight of the console.
- Technical deep-dive (11:30–12:45 PT): allocate the first 15 minutes to context/recap (we'll play the recorded exec piece if any members missed it), then hands-on demo of request routing, batching, and failure fallbacks.
- Resource ask: I can lead both sessions but would appreciate Lauren on the exec piece for commercial coverage and one engineer (Kenji) on standby for troubleshooting during the deep-dive.

If BrightWorks confirms split, Mina — please send two calendar invites with clear titles ("BrightWorks — Exec Briefing (CTO)", "BrightWorks — Technical Deep Dive"). I'll load the condensed slide deck and bring the recording consent form.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachment: exec_brief_notes.docx (stub)

From: Alex Harper <alex.harper@brightworks.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightworks.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CTO may need to join late — can we adjust demo?

Thanks, Mina + Marcus — split works best for us. Samir confirmed he can join 10:45–11:15 PT and will leave the rest to the engineering team. Kenji on standby sounds great.

Two quick asks:
- Can you include a 3–4 bullet one-pager in the exec invite PDF that calls out ROI and SLA guarantees? That helps Samir prepare during deplane.
- Please send invites with both Zoom and dial-in; our security team sometimes blocks external links.

Once we have the two invites I will accept and route to Samir + the engineering attendees. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Alex
Alex Harper
Director, IT Strategy | BrightWorks
